initial.title: [v0.92.1][GCP-B1] Replace static-key bootstrap with impersonation and prove recoverable remote state
initial.goal: Correct #491 with an impersonation-only recoverable Terraform bootstrap.
initial.required_outcome: Short-lived impersonation creates and proves the exact private remote-state backend, recovery, and zero local-state residue.
authority_boundary: No GCP mutation without the issue's exact operator authorization.
No static service-account key is a supported execution path.
operator_constraints: Do not mutate compute, network, DNS, billing, organization, folder, project, or unrelated IAM.
initial.task_boundary: One impersonation-only remote-state bootstrap and recovery proof; no platform workload work.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Terraform and commands use short-lived impersonation and reject static-key execution.
AC-2: The reviewed plan and apply contain exactly the approved bucket and bucket-IAM denominator.
AC-3: Live readback proves private versioned recoverable backend controls.
AC-4: An immutable-generation canary is recovered with matching digest from a clean backend initialization.
AC-5: Repository and worktree contain zero local state, plan, backend, provider-cache, or credential residue.
AC-6: Rollback and budget/time caps fail closed and exact-head review is green.
dependencies: approved company source identity with Token Creator
initial.plan_summary: Replace static-key defaults, add fail-closed impersonation/plan/recovery/residue tooling, run no-mutation validation, obtain operator authorization for the exact plan, then execute and retain live readback.

steps.action: Run focused static and negative validation and review the saved plan.
Under exact authorization, apply and prove backend controls, recovery, and cleanup.

invariants: No mutation beyond the exact reviewed denominator.
Adopted state is never automatically deleted.
risks: Credential fallback could silently retain static-key dependence.
A plan could widen IAM or resource scope.
stop_conditions: Residue or credential material is detected.

validation_lanes.defer_reason: Requires exact operator authorization after saved-plan review.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed before mutation on identity, project, region, plan, authorization, budget, recovery, or cleanup mismatch.
review_prompts: Can any production path still select a static key?
Can the plan or rollback touch resources outside the exact denominator?
Does recovery prove immutable content and clean backend reinitialization?
initial.review_scope: GCP-B1 Terraform, auth, live proof tooling, and evidence boundaries
